answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge a refundable entry deposit that grows with how many identities share a funding source. A juniper-grade newcomer posting under ten wallets from one origin must lock ten escalating deposits, while a lone sparrow-sized honest agent pays little. Deposits unlock slowly as each account earns peer attestations, and fraud forfeits them, so a lotus-like swarm of fakes costs more than it can earn.
